packages.title: gnews

manifest.title: gnews
manifest.appDescription: A deliberately tiny TV-first launcher for ABC57, WSBT 22, WNDU 16 News Now, and ROAR. Use the remote arrows to choose a tile, press OK to watch, and press Back to return to the same tile.

packages.shortDescription: Four-button access to Michiana local news and ROAR.

packages.title: LG App Update Blocker

manifest.title: LG App Update Blocker
manifest.appDescription: LG App Update Blocker with 5-way remote navigation, visible focus, OK-button support, deterministic startup focus, and safe exclusion of text-entry fields from D-pad navigation.

packages.shortDescription: LG update blocker with TV remote navigation.

packages.title: YouTube AdFree

manifest.title: YouTube AdFree
manifest.appDescription: YouTube AdFree built from webosbrew upstream 0.5.3 with GTV patches that harden Home/feed ad filtering against fresh-launch timing, wrapped renderer shapes, continuations, and known masthead/promotion renderer variants; extend the existing Remove Shorts option across Home, Search, subscriptions, channel/browse shelves, pagination, and continuation responses; suppress inline playback promotion surfaces that can present QR-code and Shop overlays; and harden the inherited playback JSON hook so unrelated JSON.stringify calls retain native behavior and avoid unnecessary deep cloning.

packages.shortDescription: Ad-free YouTube with hardened feed ad blocking, Shorts removed, and sponsored playback overlays suppressed.
